# Data Foundations for AI — Exercise Sheets

Work in tables of 3–4. Each lab ends with something written down that you take back to work.

## Lab 1 — Audit 10 datasets

*Module 1: AI-ready data · about 96 minutes*

**With demo 1** (`python demos/01_audit_datasets.py`): Audit ten datasets you actually depend on, with the data owner in the room if possible. The lowest line of the top-priority dataset is your first ticket.

**Write down:** 1) what you tried · 2) what the result was · 3) one thing you will do differently at work this month.

## Lab 2 — Catalogue entries

*Module 2: Catalogue, lineage, stewardship · about 96 minutes*

**With demo 2** (`python demos/02_catalogue_and_lineage.py`): Write catalogue entries for three datasets in the YAML format. Trace one KPI on your dashboard back to its source tables. How many hops? How many owners?

**Write down:** 1) what you tried · 2) what the result was · 3) one thing you will do differently at work this month.

## Lab 3 — Monitored pipeline

*Module 3: Pipelines · about 96 minutes*

**With demo 3** (`python demos/03_monitored_pipeline.py`): Re-run day 2 twice. Is your target unchanged? Then break the schema on day 3 and decide: fail the load, or quarantine and continue?

**Write down:** 1) what you tried · 2) what the result was · 3) one thing you will do differently at work this month.

## Lab 4 — Curated knowledge base

*Module 4: Knowledge bases for GenAI · about 96 minutes*

**With demo 4** (`python demos/04_curated_knowledge_base.py`): Run the curation report on a real shared folder. How many documents survive? Who owns the refresh of each survivor?

**Write down:** 1) what you tried · 2) what the result was · 3) one thing you will do differently at work this month.
